text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I placed in the top three…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I couldn't sink my teeth into the lead… Even though I've been sharpening them precisely for this day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: There's no point in hunting prey that can't put up a fight.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: One more step. If I can take just one more step…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: All right. I'm definitely going to get it next time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What we need… You mean, something that I'm currently lacking?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …I think I know what it is. You do too, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Then it's settled. We've just got to focus on it in training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Let's go. Time to the start the counterattack!
